name: sublevel-ai
description: SUBLEVEL's AI server: lets the phone app use Claude with an access code instead of a personal Anthropic key.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your Anthropic API key, from [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com) → API Keys. Set a monthly spend limit there first: it caps what the server can ever cost you.

SOLANA_RPC.description: Where the server checks USDC payments. The default public address works but is rate-limited; a free mainnet URL from a provider like [Helius](https://www.helius.dev) is more reliable.

SOL_ADDRESS.description: The Solana wallet (your Phantom address) that receives USDC from people buying AI credit.

LEDGER.description: Stores paid access codes and their remaining credit. Created for you; nothing to set.
